orders.text: Hülsen, march your corps at once east along the high road past Bříství, keeping north of the road until your head is well beyond Křečhoř, then wheel to the right and attack Křečhoř village and the oak wood from the east, taking the enemy's right in flank; carry the heights behind it and hold them until the infantry of the army comes up on your right.
game_clarifications: Hülsen: the order «Hülsen, march your corps at once east along the high road past Bříství, keeping north of the road until your head is well beyond Křečhoř, then wheel to the right and attack Křečhoř village and the oak wood from the east, taking the enemy's right in flank; carry the heights behind it and hold them until the infantry of the army comes up on your right.» names an objective I cannot identify; which place or body is meant?

orders.text: Moritz of Anhalt-Dessau, continue the march of all the infantry east along the high road behind Hülsen. Do not turn the head of the column to the right until it has passed Křečhoř and Hülsen is engaged. Then form to the right and attack in echelon from the left, Tresckow's wing first in close support of Hülsen, each brigade going in on the left of the one before. Bevern's wing is refused, to keep to the north of the high road out of range of the enemy batteries, and is not to be drawn into any attack on the enemy's front.
game_clarifications: Bevern: the order «Moritz of Anhalt-Dessau, continue the march of all the infantry east along the high road behind Hülsen. Bevern's wing is refused, to keep to the north of the high road out of range of the enemy batteries, and is not to be drawn into any attack on the enemy's front.» is unclear; what am I to do?
